pullRequests.title: Co-op sweep: the world under menus, deaths reported (mod interface 1.9)
pullRequests.author: Veradictus
pullRequests.head: feat/coop-sweep
pullRequests.body:
The co-op mod's sanity sweep found that pausing in one game despawned mobys in the other: the pause menu swaps the game's moby array for its own (select_moby_context), so the world calls read the pause menu's mobys, and the mod took the level's for gone. This fixes the port side and adds what the mod needs so that a menu never stops or empties a party's world.
Port (rac1, PAL and NTSC-U)

The world calls always address the level's own mobys. While the pause menu's context is up they read the…

pullRequests.title: fix(editor): ship typed pvar layouts with installed tools
pullRequests.author: llesieur99
pullRequests.head: fix/pal-elevator-parameters-v2
pullRequests.body:
Replaces #94 after rebuilding on the current master history.
Typed pvar edits could work in a source checkout but be ignored by installed editor tools, which do not carry the decompilation headers used by class_layouts(). Generate validated data-only layouts during desktop and Android bundling and load them when headers are absent. Source checkouts continue to use their headers. Invalid packaged definitions fail explicitly instead of becoming a cached empty layout.

pullRequests.title: feat(sdk): add persistent RAC1 savestate support
pullRequests.author: ReaperOfVeriod
pullRequests.head: codex/rac1-persistent-savestates
pullRequests.body:
Summary
This extends the merged warm-savestate APIs so an external mod can provide persistent multi-slot RAC1 savestates. Save/load policy and slot-file handling remain in Project Save Clank.

Add mod API 1.10 for Developer menu entries, dynamic slot labels, menu actions, and play readiness/status.
Make snapshots safe at tick boundaries and restore guest memory plus essential runtime state for the same game build and disc across launches.
